---
title: "Fiche de mathématiques"
params:
  notion: "addition_fractions"
  support: "decouverte"
  variantes: 5
output:
  html_document: default
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
banque = eduschool::questions(params$notion)
```

```{r contenu, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
fichier = system.file("notions", params$notion, paste0(params$support, ".md"),
                      package = "eduschool")
stopifnot(nzchar(fichier))
cat(paste(readLines(fichier, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
```

```{r graphique, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
if (params$notion == "pythagore") {
  print(eduschool::illustrer_question(eduschool::question(banque$questions[[1L]])))
} else if (params$support == "decouverte") {
  parts = data.frame(part = factor(seq_len(6)), valeur = rep(1, 6),
                     selection = factor(c(rep("1/2", 3), rep("1/3", 2), "reste")))
  print(ggplot2::ggplot(parts, ggplot2::aes(part, valeur, fill = selection)) +
          ggplot2::geom_col(colour = "white") +
          ggplot2::labs(title = "Sixièmes : 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
          ggplot2::theme_minimal())
}
```

```{r revision, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (params$support == "revision") {
  cat("\n## Exercices corrigés\n\n")
  for (definition in banque$questions) {
    q = eduschool::question(definition)
    cat("**", q$enonce, "**\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("**Réponse :** ", q$reponse, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("**Explication :** ", q$correction, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
